exposure: women with a caesarean section associated with near-miss complication
vaginal birth associated with near-miss complication
women with a vaginal birth associated with near-miss complication
cohort: 950 women and their babies in Burkina Faso
finding: While physical effects of life-saving caesareans were similar to uncomplicated childbirth, negative economic, social, and reproductive effects were observed, including increased debts, sexual violence, and lower fertility 4 years postpartum.
